literal_meaning: হাড়ে হাড় (bone to bone, implying close physical clash)
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুই দল মাঠে হাড্ডাহাড্ডি লড়াই করছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The two teams are fighting toe to toe on the field.
Their debate is going blow for blow.
note: Often used in contexts of physical or verbal confrontations in everyday Bengali speech.
